goal: A bounded stronger 7B training follow-up with a new prospective evaluation; no guaranteed pass count.
initialization: Fresh rank16 all-seven-projection adapters on the pinned original NF4 base; no v2 adapter transfer or optimizer resume.
development_note: Original inspected v1 tests remain development-only. Former v2 fresh tests are now training targets and receive no v3 evaluation credit.
prospective_exposure_note: No prior model-generated or SFT-target records for the new trio were found in audited repository artifacts. Public fixed contracts/references/baselines existed. No pretraining or external-interaction cleanliness claim.
training_source: Only the eleven configured curated fixed Triton sources, prepared with coding-assistant support. New held-out and development sources excluded from SFT targets.
prompt: Unchanged contract_v2 with identical template per method; no new held-out target solutions or diagnostics in model training.
sampling: Raw on-policy temperature=1, top_p=1, top_k=0; max_new_tokens=1536 for all arms. No selective extension.
schedule: Eight supervised epochs of eleven examples (88 updates), then sixteen groups of two GRPO samples. The configured order is retained; the first five operators receive a second GRPO group.
training_reward: Correctness-gated existing speed-sensitive PASS reward; all non-PASS rewards zero. Equal rewards have zero relative advantage. Actual optimizer updates are measured, not inferred from group counts.
reference_policy: Original pre-SFT frozen quantized base through disabled adapters; not an SFT-checkpoint KL anchor.
stopping_rule: One frozen schedule from fresh initialization. Complete training before new test inspection; retain all scheduled evaluation methods and failures. No replacing tasks, selecting a better checkpoint after fresh tests, or retuning to achieve 3/3.
resources: Existing laptop RTX5060 and public pinned model files only; no paid service, additional account, quota bypass, or rented GPU.
readiness_gate: Actual expanded-adapter longest-training-example and synthetic maximum-context finite backward/update probes plus eleven FP16 fixed-target strict checks must pass before training. Probe weights are discarded; probes are not quality results.
comparison_limit: New tasks, seed, rank, modules and training schedule differ from v2. V2 and v3 are unpaired and never pooled. Each within-v3 control uses its own identical inference contract and budget labels.
limitations: N=3, one model seed and single fixed-source corpus; no significance or universal correctness claim.
Shared-family compositional transfer under public contracts, not unseen-family OOD.
Tiny-corpus SFT may memorize; sparse reward variance and original-base KL can limit useful GRPO updates.
No causal SFT necessity, RL-only improvement, model-scale threshold, full-parameter 7B, FSDP, or convergence claim.
